layer1.name: Zirtual
layer1.one_liner: Subscription virtual assistants for busy professionals, from $199/month.
layer1.description: Matched customers with a dedicated US-based assistant on a monthly plan. Assistants were employees rather than contractors, which was the quality pitch and the cost structure.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down abruptly, laying off staff overnight before a partial restart under new ownership. The postmortem centres on unit economics: employee assistants at that price point did not cover their own cost.
